source: four user-supplied photos of the printed V3 speed coupons
observations: All four show raised accumulations at widened tree junctions and some strings; longer straight strokes are comparatively regular. No clear acceptable winner from these photos. Views and magnifications differ, so quantitative ranking is not established.
conclusion: Changing requested wall speed alone did not remove the defect. This does not exclude effects of acceleration, pressure transients or motion at very short features.
user_observed_formation: User did not watch whether the defect appeared during deposition or on a later pass.
filament_identity: User states brand Amazon; exact model, PLA versus PLA Silk and labelled temperature range remain unconfirmed. Current project uses a PLA Silk profile, 215 C, flow .9702.
independent_slicer_probe: At 25 mm/s, changing only sample C object wall_generator from arachne to classic reintroduces Gap infill on every gold layer. This is not evidence of a physical fix.
next_information_needed: Photo or exact text of the spool label showing product type and nozzle temperature range before choosing a temperature/material-profile test.
